notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR28: a program the MCS schedules gets the source terminal's name in data-name-3 of its INITIAL input-output CD, and "In all other cases" that item is initialized to spaces, before the first Procedure Division statement. CommunicationEmitter.EmitActivation calls MessageControl.InitialArea once per instance; InitialArea writes the scheduled terminal (WISEOWL_COBOL_MCS_SCHEDULED) only for the run unit's main program, else spaces, and locks it (GR30). Probes at 85: unscheduled, VALUE "PRESET" becomes spaces with the other VALUEs kept; scheduled T1 gives T1 and the first RECEIVE returns its message; a CALLed program's INITIAL CD is spaces, keeps its last-used state on a second CALL and is spaces again after CANCEL; two INITIAL CDs and INITIAL with USING refused (COBOL6169).

next.reason: 1985: "symbolic name of the communication terminal ... is placed in the data item referenced by data-name-3 of the input-output CD"; 2023: "No communication description entry or INITIAL clause; no 2023 clause holds the CD feature and no candidate covers it.". 2023 has no clause holding the CD feature. The candidates, including the RECEIVE statement rule, do not address the input-output CD, the INITIAL clause or setting data-name-3.
